strings.Enter キーは「リストの次の曲へ」に使うため割り当てられません: Enter is reserved for “next track in list” and cannot be assigned.
strings.どのタイミングでも、再生中に Enter を押すとすぐこの曲へ進みます（前の曲は: In every mode, pressing Enter during playback jumps to this track at once (the previous track stops with its own fade-out). The first track of a list plays with the start key.
strings.キューシート（.ccsc のフォルダ）を選んでください: Please choose a cue sheet (a .ccsc folder).
strings.テンキーの enter は Enter と同じ「リストの次の曲へ」です（割り当て: Keypad enter works like Enter: “next track in list” (cannot be assigned).
strings.ピンクの線が左右です（上が L、下が R、真ん中が中央）。左の PAN に足し合: The pink line is the pan (top = L, bottom = R, middle = center). It is added to the pan on the left. Click the line to add a mark, drag a mark to move it, ⌥-click or press Delete to remove it. Click between two marks to shape the transition with the white squares.
strings.・リストの曲をダブルクリックすると、その曲が「次」になる。Enter で鳴る: • Double-click a track to make it “next”. Enter plays it
strings.・リスト（幕間 BGM など）は1つずつ鳴る。Enter で次の曲へ進む（鳴って: • Lists (e.g. intermission music) play one at a time. Enter goes to the next track (or starts the selected list)
strings.曲のファイルを選んで、リストの最後に足す: Choose track files and add them to the end of the list
strings.次の割り当てを外しました。スペース・Enter・Esc は操作用のキーです。\n: These assignments were removed. Space, Enter and Esc are control keys.
strings.水色の線が音量です。線をクリックでマークを足す、マークをドラッグで動かす、Alt: The light-blue line is the volume. Click the line to add a mark, drag a mark to move it, ⌥-click or press Delete to remove it. Click between two marks to shape the transition (Bézier curve) with the white squares. The fade-in rises to the level of the first mark.
strings.自動では鳴りません。前の曲が終わってもリストは待機したままで、Enter を押す: Does not play automatically. The list waits after the previous track ends and plays when you press Enter (pressing the start/stop key while waiting stops the list). With a number of seconds, it waits that long after Enter (the previous track stops when Enter is pressed). Press Enter again while waiting to play at once.
strings.「%@」は読み込めていないため、鳴らせません。: “%@” has not been loaded and cannot be played.
